credit_suisse_2023.title: Credit Suisse — March 2023

credit_suisse_2023.context: Silicon Valley Bank failed on Friday 10 March 2023; on 15 March Credit Suisse's largest shareholder ruled out further capital and the SNB announced a liquidity backstop that night; UBS's takeover of Credit Suisse was announced on Sunday 19 March.
credit_suisse_2023.selection_rule: Windows are the three named crises every Swiss treasurer remembers, fixed in advance; no window was chosen after seeing the results.
credit_suisse_2023.causal_note: Causal reconstruction — not the live record. The live record starts 2026-08-17; see the Proof page.
